title: Law to let residents sue over AI violations and collect rewards
summary: This bill would let any New Yorker file a complaint with the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection alleging a violation of the city's artificial intelligence laws, which the agency must investigate unless frivolous or duplicative. If the city pursues enforcement based on the complaint, the person who filed it would get 25 percent of any money recovered, or 50 percent if they are authorized to bring the case or serve the violation notice themselves. The law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
